name: Caged Sun — "Creatures you control of the chosen color get +1/+1"
notes: Found behind an inert check of the subject probe in tests/sweep.py (2026-10-13). The chosen colour was written where 'the chosen color' stood ('Creatures you control of Red get +1/+1'), which the filter did not read, so the effect reached nobody. It now goes in front of its noun (also Heraldic Banner, Gauntlet of Power, Hall of Triumph).
